name: find_people
title: Find People
description: Find people on Airsup by name, identity, role, company, expertise, or other natural-language description. Use this when you want to contact someone but do not already have their person_id. Do not use this if an exact person_id is already known.

query.description: Natural-language description of the person or people to find, for example 'Konstantin Saifoulline' or 'humanoid actuator engineers in China'.

maximum_results.description: Maximum number of matching people to return.

person_id.description: Stable Airsup identifier for this person.

description.description: information explaining who this person is and why they may match the query.
